note: Pre-release list: GTA VI releases 26 November 2026. This trophy list is the pre-release list published by Exophase and PSNProfiles and cross-checked against GTABase, Push Square, KeenGamer, GamesFuze and EGamers. It is NOT yet the official PlayStation-published list, and detailed step-by-step guidance for several trophies is still unconfirmed in published sources. Where a step is unconfirmed, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

roadmap.summary: Finish the chapters and the story missions, meet the strangers, and grab the one possibly-missable meditation early. Nothing else here can be missed.
roadmap.title: Play the story

roadmap.summary: After the story, sweep Leonida: activities, races, robberies, collectibles and the stranger strands you have left.
roadmap.title: Free-roam cleanup

roadmap.summary: 250 stunts, gold at all 12 shooting ranges, 100 WAiNK scans and the rest of the 100% checklist. Expect roughly 200 hours to the platinum (Push Square puts the ceiling near 300).
roadmap.title: The long grinds

roadmap.summary: Vice Got a Price! pops when the other 54 are earned. Never use cheats: they disable trophies and the save.
roadmap.title: Platinum

exophase.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles (pre-release list, via the kit)

trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task: follow the roadmap, finish the 100% checklist for A Long Road, and this pops last. Budget around 200 hours to the platinum (Push Square estimates up to 300).
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it pops at the mission's end. It is a hidden trophy, so its name and description stay hidden in this guide until you tick it earned while spoiler mode is on.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 1 to its final mission; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapter trophies cannot be missed: replaying a mission is always possible.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 2. The name is shown here exactly as the published list prints it, asterisks included.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete Chapter 3 in full; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete Chapter 4 in full; the trophy pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and the only gold story trophy. Finish the game's final mission and it pops. After the credits you keep free roam, so every other trophy can still be earned.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the heist mission The Cartel Heist; the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Child's Play; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Headliners; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the second gold. Reach 100% completion: every robbery (8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations), gold at all 42 Shooting Range challenges in 12 ranges, all 42 drone races, 15 Target Deck targets for Bret, 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, and 100 WAiNK scans. Track it in the game's own stats screen and work through this guide's checklist alongside it. Sources: Push Square and KeenGamer for the checklist counts.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida: jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the total. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past this one. Stunts are the free-roam grind, so chip away at them between other tasks rather than farming them in one sitting. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, meditation, hunting, stunts and one more of the open-world pastimes. One attempt each is enough; you do not need to win or finish them all. Sources: GTABase and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges in Leonida. This is one of the two silver skill grinds: learn each range's weapon and target pattern, and retry a challenge until the gold score lands. The 100% checklist also requires it. Sources: Push Square and GTABase.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 drone-race locations. There are 42 drone races in total, so you can pick the easiest race at each location. The 100% checklist wants all 42 won. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida's race types. Any 20 distinct races count, so take the short, easy ones first and spread them across race types. Sources: GTABase and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are one of the 9 activity types, so this also feeds Master of None. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play an arcade game through to its end at any arcade in Leonida. Any single arcade game counts. Sources: GTABase and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy, unmissable. Work through Andy's stranger mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story, so none of them can be missed. It is a hidden trophy, so spoiler mode hides it until earned.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy, unmissable. Work through Kenton's stranger mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy, unmissable. Work through Billy's stranger mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The five named stranger finals in this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of them; find three more stranger strands in free roam. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy, unmissable. Work through Randy's stranger mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy, unmissable. Work through Tyrone's stranger mission strand to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida (15 of 18 meditations count toward the 100% checklist). THIS IS THE ONLY TROPHY REPORTED AS POSSIBLY MISSABLE: sources report Lucia can meditate on the balcony in Chapter 1, on the morning after the mission Down to Earth, and it is not yet confirmed whether that spot is required or can be revisited later. Do it the first morning it is available, just in case, and meditate at every other spot as you find them. Sources: Push Square, KeenGamer and GTABase.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret, as part of his Target Deck: 15 targets in total, and the 100% checklist wants 100 of 255 animal studies. The exact steps for this trophy are still unconfirmed in published sources (GTABase flags it), so the guide here is the description itself plus the Target Deck context, not a step-by-step walkthrough.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets by finding cards across Leonida. Cards are a pure collectible hunt: check the map and your collection screen as you go, and sweep each region in free roam. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan at 100 locations across Leonida. The 100% checklist wants exactly 100 WAiNK scans, so this trophy and that checklist line finish together. Work region by region so you do not revisit the same spots. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80 challenges, so keep completing them after this pops. Challenges span races, stunts, shooting and more, so they tick over while you chase other trophies. Sources: GTABase and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in a fast car in open country where you can break line of sight, and keep your partner with you until the stars clear. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route of three close shops, rob quickly, and keep moving: the chain breaks if the wanted level drops. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 vehicle scans, so keep scanning every new vehicle you see with the in-game scanner. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Set it up where enemies group together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. Sources: GTABase and KeenGamer.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: get a plane moving at VCIA without a scheduled flight. The exact steps are still unconfirmed in published sources, so treat the description as the goal and the airport as the place, and check the cited guides as they update. It is a hidden trophy, so spoiler mode hides it until earned.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: A Rhino tank trophy: get into a Rhino and put it to use. The description is deliberately vague and the exact steps are still unconfirmed in published sources; the tank itself is the hint. It is a hidden trophy, so spoiler mode hides it until earned.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before the alarm. A stealth approach, not a smash-and-grab. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. The 100% checklist wants all 8 bank vault robberies, so this is the halfway mark. Plan the escape route before you go in. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck on the road and escape with the take. Ambush it where the road is quiet, grab the cash, and lose the wanted level before it counts. Sources: GTABase and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida until the map is filled in. Drive and fly through each area; the trophy pops once the last unexplored corner is covered. It pairs naturally with the collectible sweeps. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. The 100% checklist wants all 39 gang operations robbed, so this trophy is the first gang covered and the checklist is the full sweep. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact steps for this trophy are still unconfirmed in published sources (GTABase flags it), so the guide here is the description itself: the place is Ocean Beach, the act is a cocktail with a view. It is a hidden trophy, so spoiler mode hides it until earned.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in the classic style the description hints at. The exact steps are still unconfirmed in published sources (GTABase flags it), so the guide here is the description itself rather than an invented walkthrough. It is a hidden trophy, so spoiler mode hides it until earned.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through there. The exact steps are still unconfirmed in published sources: the description names the place, and the act is bowling-related, so this guide does not invent the missing steps. It is a hidden trophy, so spoiler mode hides it until earned.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership trophy whose description is deliberately vague. The exact steps are still unconfirmed in published sources, so this guide records the description as published rather than guessing the partnership it means. It is a hidden trophy, so spoiler mode hides it until earned.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: A choice trophy: make a story choice and live with it. The exact steps are still unconfirmed in published sources, so this guide does not invent which choice it is; watch for a decision point where the game itself flags the consequence. It is a hidden trophy, so spoiler mode hides it until earned.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: retry something and succeed on the second attempt. The exact steps are still unconfirmed in published sources (GTABase flags it), so the guide here is the description itself rather than an invented walkthrough. It is a hidden trophy, so spoiler mode hides it until earned.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A mystery trophy whose description is a reaction, not an instruction. The exact steps are still unconfirmed in published sources (GTABase flags it), so this guide records the description as published rather than guessing the event. It is a hidden trophy, so spoiler mode hides it until earned.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by: strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. The exact steps are still unconfirmed in published sources (GTABase flags it), so the guide here is the description itself: a melee attack from a moving vehicle. It is a hidden trophy, so spoiler mode hides it until earned.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them through contacts to clean them, and the total is cumulative. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. The total is cumulative across every shop type, so it ticks over naturally as you buy weapons, clothes, food and vehicles; check your spending in the stats screen. Sources: GTABase and GamesFuze.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties, for about $160,000 in total, through Vice City Real Estate once it opens after the Daily Driver mission in Chapter 2. Garages are where your vehicle collection lives, so buy them as you build the collection. Sources: Push Square and GTABase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, scan or register them through the app, and the count is cumulative. Sources: GTABase and Push Square.
trophies.name: On the Spot
